Package com.bilt.pos.session.identity

Class IdentifyResult

java.lang.Object
com.bilt.pos.session.identity.IdentifyResult
public final class IdentifyResult extends Object
Result of a member identification.

Member data (memberId, rewards, pointBalance) is populated only when getStatus() is IdentifyStatus.FOUND; the other statuses describe why no member is attached (not found, suspended, cancelled on the terminal).
